A '''frog''' is a level 67 monster found in the [[jade vine maze]] from the [[Back to my Roots]] quest. Lower-levelled players should not underestimate these poisonous monsters, although they are not aggressive. An [[antipoison]] potion, preferably [[super antipoison|super]] or better, is recommended while fighting them.
